 Fiyin Olowokandi Wed, October 28, 2026 at 7:00 PM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Judi Dench Makes Rare Confession About Late Husband 25 Years After His Death Judi Dench is taking a trip down memory lane. The legendary actress is opening up about a love story that has persisted across decades.
 Dench married fellow actor Michael Williams in 1971, and the pair remained together for 30 years until his death from lung cancer in 2001 at the age of 65.
 She has kept their relationship close to her heart as she navigates new chapters of life and love.
 Judi Dench Admits She Still Misses Her Late Husband In New Memoir
 MEGA
 In her new memoir, "Is It Too Late to Make a Run For It?" Dench and longtime collaborator Brendan O'Hea detail the award-winner's career and the people who helped her through the ups and downs.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Despite her stellar acting journey that included iconic characters like M in the "James Bond" series and Queen Elizabeth I in "Shakespeare in Love," one thing that has clung to the actress has been her marriage to her late husband, Williams.
 "I still miss him," the 91-year-old admitted to People Magazine . "Even now, 25 years on, I imagine he's going to walk in through the front door."
 In the book, Dench also reflects on her remarkable profession, which includes sold-out performances on Broadway and London's West End, as well as numerous accolades, including an Oscar, Tony, Golden Globes, Oliviers and BAFTAs.
 Judi Dench Once Dreamed Of Having 6 Children With Late Husband Michael Williams
 Judi Dench and husband Michael Williams with their newborn baby daughter Finty (1972) pic.twitter.com/o3qPUmFmgJ 
 — Edward Elderman (@edwereddie) July 1, 2023 
 Her latest reflections also bring to mind her past comments about the family she had hoped to build with the late actor. Two years ago, Dench revealed she had wanted 6 children with Williams.
 Advertisement Advertisement "Michael and I said, 'We're going to have six children," the Hollywood veteran recalled in an interview . "We had one, beautiful Finty, and we didn't have the other five; it just didn't happen. I worked a lot. I suppose you don't stop to consider, really."
 Even though they had only one child, the couple still shared a story filled with love, laughter, and a mutual passion for acting.
 They were partners on and off screen, often collaborating professionally and letting their natural chemistry shine.

 Judi Dench Shared Why She Won't Marry David Mills After 25 Years Together
 News Licensing / MEGA
 While Dench continues to cherish her life with Williams, she is still moving forward and has found love again with conservationist David Mills. The long-standing 25-year romance has, however, taken an unconventional path.
 Advertisement Advertisement Despite being together for almost three decades, the lovebirds have no plans to marry. "We talked about [marriage], but I think we are far better off as we are, as we have got two separate houses. And we are either in one or the other, and we are four miles apart," Mills explained.
 Dench further confirmed Mills was not going to propose given their older age, according to HELLO! Magazine .
 Judi Dench Loathes Being Called A National Treasure
 ZUMAPRESS.com / MEGA
 As shown in her partnership, Dench has never followed conventional expectations in her personal life.
 She has also been unapologetic about how she feels about the labels people have attached to her longstanding work.
 Advertisement Advertisement When asked how she feels about being called a national treasure, the veteran responded, "Loathe it." She compared the sentiment to being an old object forgotten away, sounding like a dusty old relic.
 She added that she has had to deal with people asking when she would retire or if it was not time she put her feet up, to which she responded, "No, it bloody well isn't," per The Blast .
 Judi Dench Revealed Devastating Diagnosis
 MEGA
 Another layer was added to the 91-year-old's desire to remain active when she talked about her heartbreaking health condition.
 Dench was diagnosed with age-related macular degeneration (AMD) in 2012, a condition that has slowly taken away her eyesight.
 Advertisement Advertisement As a result, the actress has been forced to take a backseat in her 70-year professional life, as the condition means she can't do stage plays or act in films anymore. It has worsened to the point that Dench admitted she can barely recognize faces anymore.
